newsitem.title: USA: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE TRADE $65, VIGOROUS - USDA.
newsitem.headline: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE TRADE $65, VIGOROUS - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers.
Wk to date- 119,800 Last Week - 65,000 Year Ago - 50,000
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs 65.00, few early 64.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.00-64.50. Pen mostly Choice 1250 lb Holsteins 59.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 65.00, few early 64.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 63.00-64.00.

Sales reported on 40,900 slaughter steers and 30,800 heifers; 119,800 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 34,800 formulated and 200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
